option.name: originalContent
option.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:orientation="vertical" tools:context=".ui.transform.MatchFragment">
<EditText android:id="@+id/match_name_input" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Match Name" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/place_input" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Place" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/overs_input" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Number of Overs" android:inputType="number" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/max_overs_input" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Max Overs per Bowler" android:inputType="number" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/extra_run_input" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Wide/No-Ball Extra Run Value" android:inputType="number" />
<Button android:id="@+id/date_button" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Select Date" />
<Button android:id="@+id/create_match_button" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Create Match" />
<ImageView android:id="@+id/email_icon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:src="@drawable/ic_email" android:contentDescription="Email Icon" android:layout_gravity="end" android:padding="16dp" />
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/recyclerview_transform" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1" app:layoutManager="LinearLayoutManager" />
</LinearLayout>
